item.title: Top 10 Solutions to Fix ImportError in Google App Engine Python App for Translate API
item.description:
Top 10 Solutions to Fix ImportError in Google App Engine Python App for Translate API

Encountering an ImportError when integrating the Google Translate API in your Google App Engine Python application can be frustrating. The specific error you might see is:

ImportError: No module named apiclient.discovery

This issue can stem from various factors, including library versions, incorrect installations, or deprecated modules. In this post, we’ll explore multiple solutions to help you resolve this problem effectively.
